explanations.headline: H10’s run pulled defender away to open space

claims.text: Metrica Away’s H10 ran far without touching the ball, drawing the defender away from the receiving spot.
This created a much bigger space for a teammate to receive the ball in the left half-space.

claims.text: H10 ran 21.5 metres while defender A3 followed closely with a marker follow cosine of 0.97.

explanations.headline: H10's run pulled defender A3 away to enlarge space in left half-space

claims.text: At 22.56 seconds, player H10 had moved 21.5 metres over the preceding 5 seconds, pulling marker A3 11.8 metres away from the target zone.
Marker A3’s movement closely followed H10’s run direction, with a marker follow cosine of 0.97.

The defending back line dropped 18.0 metres during H10’s run, as measured over the run period leading up to 22.56 seconds; the detector confidence for this space creation insight is 0.97.
